tip.welcome.1.message: Welcome to Decimation! An open zombie-apocalypse wasteland! This tip guide will help you in your travels, providing tips and tricks for different aspects of the mod!
tip.welcome.2.message: The aim of the game is to explore the wasteland and search for loot from a large variety of containers/objects. Different objects will contain different types of loot. For example: A military crate will contain weapons and heavy combat equipment, whilst medical loot crates contain useful life saving medical supplies.
tip.infected.1.message: Infected Humans spawn all across the wasteland. There are different types of infected, for example: a Hulk Infected will throw you into the air, whilst a Bloater will explode when close to you. Keep away from Infected, or they will infect you.
tip.infected.hulk.1.message: A Hulk Infected will shout and stomp towards you with rage and attempt to throw you into the air. They are very angry beasts. Stay clear of them!
tip.infected.bloater.1.message: A Bloater Infected will attempt to run towards you and explode on you. Their explosion is very dangerous! Be careful!
tip.infected.frail.1.message: A Frail Infected will attempt to kill you no matter what. They will lurk from the fog generated by heavy rain and/or storms. They run fast and do a lot of damage!
tip.infected.dog.1.message: Infected Dogs are dangerously fast and will attack in packs of 2 or 3. They lurk at night, especially around small villages. And you can tell if they are angry from their infectious growling.
tip.infected.crawler.1.message: Crawlers are much smaller than regular zombies and can sneak up on you! They're much slower but but harder to spot!
tip.firearms.1.message: Firearms are a vital tool in surviving in the wasteland. You can find various types of firearms in loot, from Pistols all the way up to heavy Sniper Rifles. Press R to reload your weapon, and press X to change the fire-mode.
tip.firearms.2.message: When holding any weapon, right-click to aim down the weapons ironsight. You can also aim down a scope if the scope is attached to the weapon that you are holding.
tip.firearms.3.message: Press I to open the Attachments GUI, which will allow you to place different attachments onto your gun. Place your weapon into the middle slot and place the weapon attachments into their appropriate slots.
tip.radio.1.message: You can use Radios as a means of communication for long-distance messages. Right-click (or Shift Right-click) to change the frequency of the radio.
tip.radio.2.message: Hold the radio in your players hand and type a message. Other players on the same frequency will see your message in chat.
tip.melee.1.message: Melee weapons are a great way of defending yourself from Infected or other Players. There is a large variety of different melee weapons with different damage values.
tip.melee.2.message: Some melee weapons have special features that can change the damage value of the weapon. For example: The chainsaw can be turned on if the player is carrying a Jerry Can in their hot-bar.
tip.riotshield.1.message: Riot Shields are a type of melee weapon, but they can also be used to defend yourself against firearms. Right-click with a riot-shield to toggle the riot shield as a defence. Reducing fire-arm damage by a tremendous amount.
tip.backpack.1.message: Backpacks are useful for carrying extra items. They act as an extra storage container that can be carried anywhere. You can view the contents of a backpack by placing the item into your backpacks slot from your inventory. You can also re-name backpacks by shift right-clicking a backpack item.
tip.parachute.1.message: Using a parachute is easly. Simply right-click your paracute item whilst falling/jumping to deploy it. You will gradually fall to the ground at a safe speed. Right-click again mid-air to conceal your parachute.
tip.glider.1.message: Gliders act in the same way as a parachute, but you must be falling at a high-enough speed for the glider to properly deploy. Gliders let you move much farther than a Parachute and drop much slower.
tip.syringe_morphine.1.message: Morphine Syringes are medical items that can be used to fix broken legs. Simply right-click a morphine syringe and hold it down until complete. Once complete, your leg will be fixed.
tip.syringe_cure.1.message: Cure Syringes are medical items that can cure you from infection. Simply right-click a cure syringe and hold it down until you are cured. Once complete, you will return to your normal condition.
tip.syringe_blood.1.message: Blood Syringes are medical items that can supply you with blood. These are very effective if you have lost alot of blood. Simply right-click a blood syringe and hold it down until your blood levels are higher. Once complete, your blood level will increase.
tip.syringe_infection.1.message: An Infection Syringe contains a lethal dosage of infected substance that will gradually infect the host. Hold right-click to use an infected syringe. Once complete, you will become infected.
tip.syringe_empty.1.message: You can use an empty syringe to fetch infection or blood from animals & infected. Once a syringe is used, you will receive an empty syringe that you can then reuse for other purposes.
tip.syringe_empty.2.message: You can also empty a syringe by placing it into your Crafting Table. (Note that the syringe must actually have a substance in it)
tip.bandage.1.message: Bandages & Rags can be used to stop bleeding. Simply hold right-click whilst holding the bandage and rag. Once complete, your bleeding will stop. Note that you must first clean a dirty rag before it can be used to stop bleeding.
tip.lockpick.1.message: Locked doors can be located all around the map and usually contain rare loot behind them. You can use a lock pick to unlock doors. Simply right-click a locked door with a lock pick to begin the unlocking process.
tip.fortification.1.message: Fortification can be placed anywhere on the map that isn't a safe-zone or an area claimed by another clan. Simply right-click the ground with a fortification kit to place that item. You can then right-click the fortification to conceal it.
tip.fortification.2.message: You can also use blocks like Sandbags, Barbed Wire and Metal Blocks to fortify your claimed clan territory. You can only place these blocks in claimed areas, but you can break them even in claimed clan territory.
tip.trimmingscissors.1.message: Trimming Scissors can be useful for farming and developing drugs. You can use trimming scissors to cut coca leaves from coca plants by right-clicking the coca plant with the trimming scissors.
tip.vehicles.1.message: You can use vehicles to get around the wasteland faster. Enter a vehicle by right-clicking the entity. Most vehicles require fuel, which you can get from jerry cans. Be sure to have a jerry can in your hot bar in order to start the vehicles engine.
tip.mortar.1.message: Mortar Guns can be used to fire Mortar Rounds at far distances. Simply right-click the floor with a mortar gun to deploy it, then right-click the mortar gun to enter. Once you've entered the mortar gun, hold right-click on a mortar round to fire it.
tip.mortar.2.message: To leave a Mortar Gun simply hold shift. To destroy/conceal a mortar gun, shift right-click the mortar gun entity and pick up the dropped item.
tip.signalgrenade.1.message: Signal Grenades can be used to designate your position to friends. Simply throw your grenade to your designated position and watch as the smoke deploys and gives away your position to friends & foe.
tip.grenade.1.message: Explosives can be thrown as a way to distract/harm enemy & foe. Left-click to throw your grenade far, or right-click to throw your grenade near. All grenades have differing explosion times, so be careful when throwing!
tip.propellertrap.1.message: Propeller Traps are fast-spinning self-propelled zombie hacking traps that you can find around the map. They will damage nearby enemies that are within hacking distance.
tip.selectionwand.1.message: You can use the Selection Tool to select areas for creating Zones/Safe-zones. Right-click to set the first point, then shift right-click to select the second position. You can use the in-game deci commands to expand/shrink the selected area.
tip.supplydrop.1.message: You can use a Supply Drop Radio to call in a supply drop. Simply right-click the ground with the supply drop radio to call a supply drop to that point. Once the call is made, a supply drop will drop from the sky.
tip.bottlecaps.1.message: Bottle Caps can be used as a source of trading. They act as a trading currency that you can use to trade with trader NPCs or other players. Keep your bottle caps safe! You will lose a percentage of your bottle caps if you die.
tip.condition.brokenleg.1.message: You can break your leg by taking fall damage from long drops. You can repair a broken leg by using a morphine syringe. You can find morphine syringes in medical supplies loot.
tip.condition.infected.1.message: You can become infected by taking damage from Infected humans or consuming infected substances (such as Infected Meat or Syringes). You can cure infection by using a cure syringe, which can be found in medical supplies loot.
tip.condition.bleeding.1.message: You can start to bleed if you take a lethal amount of damage. For example, taking damage from a fire-arm will definitely make you bleed! You can stop bleeding by using a bandage or clean rag. You can find these items in medical supplies loot.
tip.condition.irradiated.1.message: You can be exposed to radiation by wandering into irradiated zones. Radiation will cause you to nauseate and take small amount of damage. Your vision will also change. You can combat irradiation by wearing a respirator in irradiated zones.
tip.mre.1.message: an MRE is a military-grade edible item that you can find in military loot. An MRE can also be cooked on a campfire to increase its heal amount.

menu.disclaimer.title: Dear Player
menu.disclaimer: As we both know, Decimation is the most realistic and most fun Zombie-apocalypse mod out there. It's a shame that not everyone has had the Decimation experience. So we're asking you, the Decimation veterans, to invite as many of your friends on to play Decimation and help us grow our community! Show them how bad-ass the game is! And how kick-ass the weapons sound, or how scary the atmosphere is! Give your friends something new and entertaining to play! Thank you.
